messages:
emma_sales: ACME Health wants an offline POC in a sealed environment. They require signed installer images (ECDSA P-384) and proof of chain to their root CA. Also asking for 3-month POC pricing + extended on-call during cutover. Can we confirm feasibility?

raj_se: We can support signed images. Main question: will ACME provide their CA to sign, or do they want us to sign and hand over cert chain? HSM/KMS integration will change the SOW. @mike_poc scope delta vs full-image approach?

mike_poc: For airgapped installs we usually ship a signed bundle + detached signature and a manifest. Deltas are possible (chunked patches) but add test/QA burden. Example verification snippet we give customers:
```
# verify checksum
sha256sum redwood-image.tar.gz
# verify ECDSA detached sig (P-384)
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify acme_pub.pem -signature redwood-image.tar.gz.sig redwood-image.tar.gz
```
If they want us to use their CA, we can run signing in our CI with their provided public root for verification only.

olivia_platform: We support both flows: (A) we sign with our key and provide chain + signing attestations, (B) we provide unsigned artifacts and a signing guide for customer's KMS/HSM. Option B reduces our liability but requires customer ops to sign. Either path needs a CA exchange and an acceptance test. Also note: we can flip runtime to manual-update mode so nothing auto-updates.

legal_jess: If ACME signs artifacts themselves we need an attestation + SOW amendment describing responsibilities (who is responsible for vulnerability patching, rollback, escrow of signing keys). Pricing: dedicated packaging + engineering changes is a one-time fee. Ballpark for a 3-month POC: $25k eng + $7k/mo for extended on-call/support. Will formalize in SOW.

emma_sales: They specifically asked about upgrade cadence: they want monthly security patches available, but installations will be manual only every quarter. How do we handle the mismatch?

raj_se: We can produce monthly security bundles and also an "accumulation" quarter bundle. For small critical fixes we can produce delta patches (<50MB) that are easier to side-load. Need to agree on the minimum QA gating and rollback plan. Also clarify signature policy for deltas (same CA/signing).

mike_poc: Draft of offline delivery checklist I can produce:
- signed bundle: redwood-vX.Y.tar.gz + redwood-vX.Y.tar.gz.sig
- manifest.json (version, sha256s, dependencies, model variant pin)
- install-playbook.md with verification commands
- rollback instructions and sample commands
- chain-of-custody template for USB/physical media
I can attach a minimal example manifest and checksums.

emma_sales: ACME also wants confirmation we can pin to a quantized model variant and guarantee runtime will not auto-update. They also specified appliance disk footprint must be <120GB.

olivia_platform: :thumbsup: We can pin model variant at deployment and set runtime to manual-update mode. We'll need to run a disk-usage audit for the requested model to confirm <120GB; typical quantized variants are much smaller but will verify.

deploy_bot: artifact-uploader: uploaded signed-bundle v0.4 to staging (sha256: abc123def4567890...). @emma_sales please confirm acceptance test to hand to ACME.

emma_sales: Thanks all. Next steps: (1) @mike_poc draft install checklist + example manifest and verification snippets, (2) @legal_jess produce SOW amendment + itemized quote, (3) @raj_se confirm HSM signing option + feasibility of delta patches by EOD Friday. I'll prepare a provisional quote to send ACME. :pray:
